info.title: Prava Payments API
info.description: Server-side REST API for Prava Payments. All requests are authenticated with your secret key (sk_test_* in sandbox, sk_live_* in production).

post.description: Create a new payment session for a customer and order.

Provision an already-vaulted card synchronously, or create an interactive card-and-passkey enrollment session. Neither mode creates a payment, order, transaction, mandate, cryptogram, or payment credential.

201.description: Card provisioned or full-enrollment session created

get.description: Poll the fixed-shape lifecycle and durable outcome of a full card-enrollment session. Payment sessions are not supported by this resource.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The session_id returned for a full_enrollment request

post.description: Revoke an active payment session. Revocation is immediate and irreversible.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The session_id of the session to revoke

get.description: Retrieve enrolled cards for a customer. Only non-sensitive card metadata is returned.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: The customer ID to retrieve cards for (the user_id used when creating the session)

parameters.name: include_card_art
parameters.description: Include card art URL in response

get.description: Retrieve transaction status, card identity, and payment credentials for a session. Non-quote checkouts return credentials after authentication; quote-backed checkouts return credential-free transaction summaries and merchant lifecycle context.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The session ID returned from Create Session

post.description: Report payment execution outcome back to Prava. Always report status after checkout execution.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The session ID returned from Create Session

post.description: Delete an enrolled card for a customer. Also retires the card's network token where one exists.

customer_id.description: The customer whose card to delete (the user_id used at session creation)

card_id.description: The card to delete (same as enrollmentId from the SDK's collectPAN())

reason.description: Why the card is being deleted

was_default.description: Whether the deleted card was the customer's default

network_token_deleted.description: Whether a card-network token was retired as part of the deletion

404.description: Customer or card not found (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND / NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Mint fresh single-use card credentials against an active mandate — no passkey. Available to merchants (secret key) and agents (Ed25519 signature); not exposed over MCP. For agent callers the credentials are returned as an encrypted_payload.
Reconcile a mandate charge outcome (APPROVED / DECLINED) and settle it with the card network.

parameters.name: txnId
parameters.description: The transactionId returned from Charge a Mandate.

get.description: List the caller's mandates. Merchant keys pass customer_id; control-plane callers pass dashboard_user_id (+ agent_id). Set standing_only=true to exclude transient per-checkout mandates.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Filter to one customer (merchant keys): the external_user_id or a cus_ id.

parameters.name: standing_only
parameters.description: When true, return only standing mandates.

get.description: Retrieve one mandate with its derived balance and full charge history.

post.description: Suspend an active mandate. No charges succeed until it is resumed.
Revoke a mandate. Stops all future charges; terminal. Past charges are unaffected.

bearerAuth.description: Your secret key: sk_test_* (sandbox) or sk_live_* (production).

XResponseId.description: UUID correlation identifier for this response. Include it when contacting Prava support.

user_id.description: The merchant's stable identifier for this customer.

user_email.description: Required when Prava does not already have an email for this merchant-scoped user.

consent_id.description: Optional reference to the merchant's consent record.

enrollment_mode.description: May be omitted to preserve the existing synchronous behavior.

vault_ref_id.description: Skyflow record UUID for the card to provision.

user_id.description: The merchant's stable identifier for this customer.

user_email.description: Required when Prava does not already have an email for this merchant-scoped user.

consent_id.description: Optional reference to the merchant's consent record.

vault_ref_id.description: Optional existing Skyflow record UUID. Omit it to collect the card in Prava's secure surface.

integration_type.description: Whether to embed Prava's secure surface or open the hosted flow.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS completion URL for the hosted flow.

card_id.description: Merchant-scoped identifier for the provisioned card.

session_id.description: Identifier used to poll card-enrollment status.

iframe_url.description: Prava secure-surface URL to embed or open.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the interactive session.

outcome.description: The durable enrollment work that has completed.

passkey.description: Whether this flow registered a passkey, verified an existing one, or has not completed passkey readiness.

consent_status.description: Whether consent_id was supplied on session creation.

retryable.description: True when the cardholder can retry inside the same iframe and session.

remaining.description: Remaining spend in the current window (indicative; the network enforces the real cap).

renewsAt.description: Next cycle boundary for recurring mandates.

reference.description: Idempotency reference supplied at charge time.

amount.description: Charge amount as a decimal string, e.g. "40.00". Must be within the mandate cap.

reference.description: Idempotency key. The same mandate id + reference returns the original charge.

purchase_context.description: Optional per-charge product details — same shape as purchase_context.custom in Create Session.

credentials.description: Present for merchant callers: single-use card credentials.

encrypted_payload.description: Present for agent callers: credentials encrypted to the agent's public key.

errorMessage.description: e.g. THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED on an over-cap decline.

details.description: Optional — included for validation errors to specify which fields failed

user_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer in your system

total_amount.description: Total order amount in decimal format (e.g. "49.99")

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code — exactly 3 uppercase letters, and one of Prava's supported currencies (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, INR) - other codes are rejected

integration_type.description: How the card is collected. full_checkout = hosted redirect; embedding = mount the iframe via the SDK.

callback_url.description: For hosted checkout: the https URL Prava redirects the cardholder to after they finish. Optional for all integration types.

card.description: Pre-select a card. Send card_id OR vault_ref_id; if both are sent, card_id wins.

vault_ref_id.description: A valid UUID referencing a vaulted card

mandate_setup.description: Turns the session into mandate setup (authorize-only). Absent = standard checkout.

intent.description: mandate_setup = authorize-only (no charge/credentials). Defaults to mandate_setup when this block is present.

merchant_scope.description: Recurring frequencies force listed; any with a recurring frequency returns 400 MANDATE_RECURRING_MUST_BE_SCOPED.

valid_until.description: Ignored for one_time (clamped to 7 days). Recurring horizons: yearly 5y, monthly 2y, weekly 1y.

max_charges.description: Positive integer; per-charge cap is network-enforced.

PurchaseContext.description: What is being bought. Two modes — send exactly one: quote: true + quote_id (session built from an existing quote), or custom (describe the merchant and products yourself).

custom.description: Exactly one entry — multi-merchant sessions are not currently supported.

quote.description: Build the session from an existing quote.

quote_id.description: The opaque public quote ID returned by quote creation (for example, qte_...). Do not send a merchant checkout-session ID. Merchant and product details come from the quote.

url.description: Merchant website URL. Must use https - the URL is forwarded to Visa.

unit_price.description: Unit price as a string (no fixed decimal format enforced)

effective_until_minutes.description: How long the mandate remains effective, in minutes. Positive integer, no maximum.

session_token.description: JWT to authenticate client-side SDK operations within this session

iframe_url.description: URL for the secure card collection surface

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session expires

authorizeOnly.description: Present and true for mandate-setup sessions (no credentials issued).

card_id.description: Unique card identifier (same as enrollmentId from the SDK's collectPAN())

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card number

card_brand.description: Card brand (e.g. "visa"), or null if unknown

is_default.description: Whether this is the customer's default card

card_art_url.description: Card art image URL (only when include_card_art=true)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the card was enrolled

status.description: Overall session status. `processing` means the payment operation is still in flight: a non-quote checkout is authenticating or tokenizing, or a quote-backed merchant checkout has not reached a terminal outcome.

card_id.description: The card bound to this transaction and the source of truth whether it was preselected or selected or entered on the collection surface. Null when no card is bound.

line_items.description: Credential-bearing line items for non-quote checkouts. Omitted from quote-backed results.

txn_ref_id.description: Transaction line item reference ID (used in Report Status)

token.description: Virtual card number (network token). Non-null after credentials are generated.

dynamic_cvv.description: Single-use CVV. Non-null after credentials are generated.

error.description: Present only when the transaction has failed

merchant_res.description: Merchant checkout lifecycle context. Present only for quote-backed sessions; omitted for non-quote sessions and before an order exists. Use the top-level status as the normalized payment outcome.

status.description: Merchant lifecycle status. Examples include pending, prepared, paid, failed, prepare_failed, needs_human, and unknown.

orderId.description: Merchant checkout order ID, when available.

code.description: Safe merchant error code, when available.

message.description: Safe merchant error message, when available.

error.description: May be present when a quote-backed checkout fails.

txn_ref_id.description: The transaction line item reference ID (from Get Payment Result)

authorization_code.description: Authorization code from the merchant's payment processor

response_code.description: Processor response code, e.g. "00" for approved

amount_paid.description: Override the total amount paid, if different from the original

product_id.description: Your external product ID. Either product_id or product_ref_id must be provided.

product_ref_id.description: Prava's internal product reference ID. Either product_id or product_ref_id must be provided.

amount_paid.description: Amount paid for this specific product
